description: What this account can send from, and to whom. Call it before sending outside Primitive or from a domain other than the managed inbox. Result: ready, summary, sendable_domains, domains, next_actions, and can_send_to, the recipients it may email.

api_key.description: API key from createEmailAddress, used in place of sign-in.

name: getOutboundStatus

outputSchema.description: Where you can send from, and to whom.

address_rules_omitted.description: Address rules left out of rules; set when some were.

address_rules_partial.description: True when the address rules are a sample: an unlisted address may be allowed.

any_recipient.description: True when any recipient is allowed. Set when known.

known.description: False when the rules could not be read; then only summary is set.

rules.description: Who you may email, one rule per kind of recipient. Set when known.

address.description: address and org_member_email rules only: the address.

description.description: Who the rule allows, in words.

last_received_at.description: address rules only: last mail from it.

received_count.description: address rules only: emails received from it.

type.description: any_recipient, primitive_managed_domain, managed_zone, your_domain, address, org_member_email or opted_in_domains.

summary.description: Who this account can reach, to tell the user.

domains.description: Your domains and what each still needs.

outbound_verified.description: True when SPF, DKIM and DMARC are verified.

next_actions.description: Steps left, most important first; empty when ready.

command.description: CLI command that does it; absent when there is none.

kind.description: The step, such as add_domain or verify_domain.

ready.description: True when some domain can send now.

sendable_domains.description: Domains you can send from now.

summary.description: Plain-language status, to tell the user.

title: Get outbound status
